title: 2.3 Gross Pay
prompt: 2.3 Write a program to prompt the user for hours and rate per hour using input to compute gross pay. Use input to read a string and float() to convert the string to a number. The autograder will provide the hours and rate as input (for the sample data, the pay should be 96.25).
learning_objective: Convert input strings to numbers with float() and compute gross pay.
hint: Read hours and rate with input(), convert both with float(), multiply, then print Pay: and the result.
solution_explanation: Hours and rate arrive as strings from input(). float() converts them so you can multiply, then print labels the result as Pay:.

student.py.starter:
# This first line is provided for you

hrs = input("Enter Hours:")
student.py.solution:
hrs = input("Enter Hours:")
rate = input("Enter Rate:")
pay = float(hrs) * float(rate)
print("Pay:", pay)
